তারিখ : ২৭ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪১৭ বঙ্গাব্দ/১০ জুন, ২০১০ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division under the Ministry of Finance is the government authority responsible for issuing this notification concerning customs and value added tax.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance serves as the overarching government body overseeing customs and value added tax policy in Bangladesh.

Customs Act 1969: Section 20 of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to amend existing customs notifications through statutory orders.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(2) of this Act provides the enabling power to the Government to issue amendments to customs and tax-related notifications.
S.R.O. 74-AIN/2005: This existing customs notification is subject to further amendment regarding specific tariff headings and sub-headings as specified in the current order.
Bangladesh Customs Tariff: The order modifies various tariff entries within the existing schedule, specifically replacing multiple HS codes related to metal pipes, cables, electrical machinery, and transport vehicles with updated classifications.
